title: OpenPurpose
tagline: A unified layer for instant transfers and seamless RWA investments powered by state channels
description:
This project introduces a unified infrastructure that combines instant on/off-ramp capabilities with seamless real-world asset (RWA) investing. By leveraging a state channel–based hub-and-spoke architecture, users can move capital instantly between wallets and exchanges while also accessing tokenized real-world investment opportunities.

Beyond simple transfers, the platform enables users to participate in collective investments such as real estate, intellectual property, and other tokenized assets. Instead of fragmented tools and complex processes, users interact through a single interface where capital movement, investment, and governance can coexist.

The system reduces friction in both onboarding and investing by eliminating slow on-chain transactions and simplifying access to RWAs. This aligns with a broader vision of decentralized investment layers, where individuals can seamlessly allocate capital, collaborate through DAOs, and manage assets transparently.
how_its_made:
The platform is built on a state channel infrastructure that enables instant, low-cost transactions through off-chain execution, secured by blockchain settlement. A hub-and-spoke liquidity model allows efficient routing of funds between users, exchanges, and investment opportunities without requiring multiple direct connections.

The frontend is a browser-based interface powered by MobX for real-time state management, enabling users to seamlessly move funds and interact with investment flows. The backend is implemented in Rust to ensure high performance and reliable coordination of channels and liquidity.

We integrated exchange APIs (such as Coinbase and Bitfinex) to enable real-world on/off-ramp functionality. On top of this, we designed the system to support RWA investment flows, where users can allocate capital into tokenized assets and participate in decentralized governance structures.

A key innovation is combining liquidity infrastructure with investment access - enabling users not only to move funds instantly, but also to deploy capital into real-world assets within the same system.
auto_summary: A multi-part application for off-chain state-channel transfers, tokenized asset investing, and on-chain governance with web, API, and smart contract components.
